mechanisms: Four-sample/no-recovery baseline aborts nominal r0 at21.84s on2.027N unilateral contact and +10mmX r1 at25.82s on0.502N unilateral contact.
Tactile recovery performs one bounded retry for each of these two failures and completes both placements.
Zero-sample camera mode completes both previously failed placements without retries. All +10mmY placements already succeeded.
Adding recovery to zero-sample camera mode changes no recorded qpos value in any of the three conditions (maximum absolute difference0); no additive benefit observed.
limits: Three previously observed development conditions, one episode per factorial cell. Two robots share a scene; they are not independent replicated episodes.
Nominal camera-only outcomes were known before factorial declaration. Two existing source-matched episodes were reused, not counted as new replications.
Disabling multisampling changes both depth sampling and RGB mask discretization. These closed-loop comparisons do not isolate depth bias from RGB effects.
No observed harm in these twelve cells does not establish universal robustness, hardware safety or held-out generalization.
scope: Development-only 2x2 camera multisampling and tactile recovery factorial over three already observed training conditions. Nominal camera-only outcomes were known before declaration; reused cells are not new replications. No final/held-out condition is included.
